title: [Quality Management] Certificate of analysis shows now full name instead of the ID.
summary: The Quality Management Certificate of Analysis, General Purpose Inspection and Non-Conformance reports now show a full name instead of an ID. The report management codeunit, the Word layouts and the alternate RDL layouts were updated, and tests were added.
key_points: Reports show a full name where they used to show an ID
Covers the Certificate of Analysis, General Purpose Inspection and Non-Conformance reports
Qlty. Report Mgmt. codeunit reworked to provide the name
Word and alternate RDL layouts updated
Test library helper and new tests added
